description: Read a dispatched gig: status (DISPATCHED | IN_PROGRESS | FULFILLED | VERIFIED | CANCELLED | EXPIRED) plus — only once VERIFIED — the human answer (verdict, answer text, confidence) with its QC signal (review status/rating, agreement) and provenance. An answer that has not cleared independent review is never returned. Requires jobs:read scope.
name: opentrain_get_gig_result
